items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Michael Woods. That was one of the trombone players. He was in for awhile.

ctx.x: What about the other small groups that you've had in the recent past besides the one that works with you in the hotel. Who were the people involved in that?

Well, Bobby Smith, Ace Harris, Sonny Payne, Lee Stanfield, and Sammy Lowe. That's when it first started out. Michael Woods. That was one of the trombone players. He was in for awhile. Dolly Lyons. I have to use the vocalist too. I use her as singer. And, Eddie McCarney (inaudible) was before Sonny Payne. I'm trying to think of the other bass player after Stanfield passed. But, it can't come to me right now. Then, Jimmy Stiles came

in after that. Then, I went into the quartet. I used to go to certain towns just by myself when something came up, that I was gonna be in a jazz concert and use the musicians that they had there. I didn't do that too often cause I didn't have the time. But, they'd have a trio or a quartet or something there, then all I had to do was just join them. And, I do sessions that way.
